analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 43.4, entering oversold territory, continuing decline from 57.0 five days ago. MACD histogram at -2.7013, worsening and in weak convergence. ADX at 19.1, indicating no trend formation, with volume surge on decline suggesting potential shock-driven volatility. Failed Higher Low recovery attempt above the 5-day low of $153.33, now in a re-declining phase from current $156.22. Trading within a tight range between swing support at $155.66 and resistance at $156.49.
